description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related functions for gathering system information such as CPU load, memory, hostname, and system architecture across different platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows). It includes methods for constructing unique IDs, retrieving environment variables, and rebooting the system.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Class providing system information such as hostname, CPU load, memory, and system architecture.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Nested class capturing memory info from /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID based on device ID and system prefix.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SystemInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing system info, including hostname and CPU stats.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateCpuStats
methods.description: Updates CPU load statistics based on platform-specific data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateRealtimeInfo
methods.description: Updates real-time system info such as memory and uptime.

methods.description: Sets or unsets an environment variable.
